experiment.title: LSEG Gemma continuous joined long-window replay
experiment.objective: Test whether Notebook 39's portable continuous Gemma construction retains after-cost value through the earlier and opened same-source, same-universe LSEG blocks.

price_panel.return_definition: split-adjusted open to next common open; dividends excluded

inputs.source_regime: Reuters LSEG only; never pooled with FNSPID

return_free_checks.duplicate_score_audit: On cross-block duplicate hashes, report Spearman, sign agreement, exact equality, and absolute score differences for Gemma and FinBERT before any return is loaded.
return_free_checks.event_gate: current complete-session spread at or above the strictly-prior trailing-60 complete-observation 75th percentile after 40 complete observations
return_free_checks.incomplete_sessions: Any session lacking all 33 firm-open rows is retained on the price clock, forced to cash, and excluded from the trailing spread history.

portfolio.accounting_validation: Matrix replay must reproduce the drift-aware open-to-open ledger to 1e-12.

inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the two primary cash comparisons at q=0.05
inference.factor_control: HAC-5 market plus ten sector-spread intercept, reported separately by source block
inference.temporal_check: independently accounted chronological halves within each source block

per_block_requirements: positive total net return at 10 bps per side
break-even cost strictly above 10 bps per side
cash-comparison 95% lower interval above zero with BH q below 0.05
positive net Sharpe in both chronological halves
economic_stability_gate.cross_time_stability: Both source blocks must pass every per-block requirement.
economic_stability_gate.interpretation_if_failed: The frozen continuous construction does not retain stable after-cost value across the tested same-source periods.
economic_stability_gate.interpretation_if_passed: The temporal-fragility claim is not supported for this construction; report the positive retrospective result without promotion.

claim_boundaries: The LSEG returns and related strategy outcomes were already opened before this specification.
This design can strengthen or weaken a bounded retrospective claim but cannot create independent confirmation.
No threshold, breadth, horizon, score reducer, company subset, source filter, or cost assumption may change after this freeze.
The materiality-specific 2026 confirmation remains sealed and is not an input to this experiment.
